what: A four-voice synthesizer: two oscillators per voice, each STD (8 waves), SUPER (7 detuned saws, squares, triangles or sines), WT or GRAIN; a 12/24 dB multimode filter, two ADSRs, two LFOs, unison, delay, reverb and chorus. 16 factory presets, 16 of yours. Play it in the browser first.
author: Orian Beltrame
sounds: CC0: VCSL (Versilian Community Sample Library), plus wavetables and VOX made by the author
